neighbours.label: plural count nouns for discrete events or particles after a verb or number: saves (goalkeeping), photons, notes (sung), drops
fire: The goalie made 15 saves in the first period.
Cosmic microwave photons pass through the galaxy cluster.
She hit incredible notes that lasted for seconds.
The keeper had to make several diving saves.
A photon is a particle of light.
Each detector counts the photons that arrive.
He watched the drops run down the window.
The goalkeeper finished the match with nine saves.
quiet: The goalie made 15 friends in the first year.
Cosmic microwave maps show the galaxy cluster.
She sang an incredible song that lasted for minutes.
The keeper had to make several diving tackles.
A planet is a body orbiting a star.
Each detector counts the hours that pass.
He watched the cars run down the street.
The goalkeeper finished the match with nine yellow cards.

notes: Mixed top examples; probe confirmed saves 0.91 and photons 0.54 vs swapped nouns <0.06. Label is a loose grouping.
